Hybrid Calisthenics App (Home Workout)
Here are some core training things I've learned! They've helped me to apply.
Common misconceptions:
1.) Core is just "abs"
2.) You need to chase the burn
3.) You train your core through movement
All of these have some nuance (especially the last one!), but they've been helpful to keep in mind. Hope you all have a great day.
Legal Notice: Consult your doctor before beginning any kind of exercise program. This video does not replace a physical therapy program or consultation with a medical professional.
